facebook.caption: Phu Quoc that doesn't feel touristy. Dinh Cậu Lighthouse sits at the edge of Dương Đông town, where the river meets the sea. Climb up at golden hour and you get the whole west coast. Fishing boats below. Sky turning red. No resort crowd. Just the wind and that view. This is the version of Phu Quoc people come back for. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Climbing Dinh Cậu Lighthouse as the sun drops. The whole west coast opens up from the top. Fishing boats, red sky, zero crowds. This is why you come to Phu Quoc.
